statement: The KiDS-1000 lensing RAR is the law's zero-parameter PHANTOM FLOOR, g_lens = g_N(1+sqrt(a0/g_N)), plus a free-dust remainder.  (1) The four Fig-9 stellar-mass bins sit on ONE floor ratio (median log10(obs/pred) +0.295..+0.328 dex, spread 0.03 dex) -- the law's mass independence holds to 0.03 dex, the signature that the floor is baryon-driven rather than a free halo normalization.  (2) The observed signal is +0.355 dex (~2.3x) above the floor; the free dust (two-regime remainder: ESD deprojection and line-of-sight astrophysical normalization) carries log10(floor/obs) = -0.355 of the budget.  (3) The SHAPE of the ratio follows the law's deep branch: slope -0.526 +/- 0.010 over the full deep regime vs the law's -1/2 (5% deviation); the fit over the specified [1e-12, 1e-10] range (n=3 points) gives -0.731 +/- 0.132 -- ~1.8 sigma steeper than -1/2 and ~2.3 sigma from the law's on-grid slope -0.433, the weakest corner of the test, so V2 fails on the point estimate while the deep fit passes.  (4) No DES Y3 or HSC galaxy-galaxy lensing RAR data release exists (2026-09-15; citations recorded); the repo's independent KiDS-DR4 re-stack reproduces the floor shape (slope -0.52) and a comparable offset (+0.28..+0.46 dex), so the floor+dust frame is pipeline-robust.  HONEST LIMIT: the absolute floor offset carries the pi/2 conversion-class uncertainty (~0.2 dex, 2*pi vs B21's factor-4 ESD->g shortcut); the mass independence (0.03 dex), the shape (-0.52) and the floor-vs-dust SPLIT are conversion-robust.
